implementation_revision_note: Before GPU execution: include reverse-sign score bias so the single-head normalized baseline can explore both signs; rank causal heads among nonzero frozen directions while retaining zero-direction localization results.
historical_exposure_caveat: Exclusion is verified against the specified pilot. Other prior projects may have used these source guidelines; do not call them genuinely untouched across all research without checking exposure records.
primary_scoring: original single-token A/B logit margin, with token-boundary audit
secondary_scoring: complete space-prefixed A/B continuation log probabilities; no post-hoc replacement of primary scoring

localization.directions: both reciprocal paired directions; no selection on baseline correctness
localization.metric: donor-label margin change; normalized recovery only when donor-recipient baseline gap is nonzero

frozen_subspace: all-layer rank-2 basis from the original fit-only operators.npz; never refit on confirmation
head_sets: single and four-head versions of original selected heads and action-key patch heads ranked on fit localization

training.parameters: rank-2 coefficients only; model and basis frozen

matching: per-input fixed-query score RMS, across all edited heads and tokens; enhancement and suppression are calibrated separately and unchanged in joint edits
routing: oracle applicability signs; operator upper bound, not an end-to-end M1 evaluation
selection: choose head set, mode and dose on select only for each method; same search grid for score bias; primary candidate is optimized_subspace
confirmation: one final evaluation of frozen choices; prespecified single/multi-head and enhance/suppress/joint ablations for optimized subspace and both score baselines at each method's selected dose; no adaptation after outcomes
success: at least +0.05 absolute guideline-mean accuracy over both no edit and the stronger selected fixed/optimized score-bias baseline, with positive lower bounds of paired guideline bootstrap intervals; use 97.5% intervals for these two primary comparisons; report paired accuracy and every control regardless of sign
claim_limit: A positive new-confirmation result is not a claim of genuinely untouched confirmation unless cross-project prior exposure is established. Negative outcomes and missing cells remain in the report.
